rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Never use center-everything design. Asymmetry creates interest.
Never use pure black or gray, tint neutral grays slightly.
Text over images must meet contrast ratios (use text shadow if needed).

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid (Control Room Grid for dashboard, Tetris for marketing page)
rules: Grid items must be direct children.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

header.instructions: Sticky header. Must contain brand name, navigation links (visible on desktop), and primary CTA. Do not hide all links behind a hamburger menu on desktop.

hero.instructions: Use large Cabinet Grotesk headings. Emphasize 'Be first to know'. Include a 'Last updated' indicator showing freshness of feed.

notifications_list.style: Cardless or subtle 1px border cards. Dense data.
notifications_list.instructions: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Shadcn Table or dense list for notifications. Include 'New' badge in accent color for recent dates. Must allow search/filter by course (B.E, B.Com, MBA, etc.).

subscription_form.instructions: Use Shadcn components (Input, Select, Checkbox) but strip 'Vercel-look'. Multi-select for courses.

admin_dashboard.style: Strict grid hierarchy, dense spacing (Control Room Grid)
admin_dashboard.instructions: Use Shadcn components. Show active subscribers, notifications sent, scrape logs, outgoing WhatsApp queue. Use sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. Crisp edges.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB for separation. Add 1px delicate inner stroke for glassmorphism.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-md (max 8px) for a structured, institutional feel.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements (explicitly set text color).
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='subscribe-button').
HOVER state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.

icons.instructions: Use for UI actions (search, filter, download, external link). Clean and minimal.

image_urls.description: Modern university building with trees casting shadows. Use with a heavy white overlay (bg-white/80) or in a bento grid cell to add academic context without overwhelming the text.

instructions_to_main_agent: All logic should be built assuming pure Javascript (.js files), not Typescript.
Ensure the hero section highlights the 'Real-time WhatsApp notifications' value proposition.
Implement the scraping logic via a background worker or API endpoint that updates the feed.
Use data-testid for all inputs and buttons.
